description: Cargo suite: package-based test selection. Changed files are mapped to their owning cargo package (the nearest ancestor Cargo.toml) and the package's tests are run; there is no file glob to configure.

manifest.description: Repo-relative path to the Cargo workspace manifest (e.g. "engine/Cargo.toml") for a workspace that is not at the repo root. Omitted, cargo runs against whatever workspace the working directory roots.
